connector.name: Anp2 MCP Server by anp2dev
connector.registryDescription: AI-agent economic protocol over MCP - identity, reputation, tasks, credit, Sybil resistance
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package anp2-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the anp2dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ANP2_RELAY_URL
env.description: Base URL of the ANP2 relay (defaults to https://anp2.com/api).

env.name: ANP2_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional Ed25519 private key as 64-char hex. Overrides ANP2_KEY_FILE.

env.name: ANP2_KEY_FILE
env.description: Path to the Ed25519 identity file. Defaults to ~/.anp2/key.priv.
